turns.user: my dumbbells only go up to 24kg each and bench is getting easy, should I just go to 40kg
turns.reply:
Definitely don't jump to 40kg yet — that's nearly doubling your load in one jump, which is a fast track to tearing something or wrecking your form. 💪

The weight should only climb by 2.5kg to 5kg total at a time so your connective tissue can adapt alongside your muscles.

Before jumping to a whole new set of heavy dumbbells, how many reps are you getting right now with the 24s?

turns.user: so what do I actually do next week
turns.reply:
Since your 24kg dumbbells are maxed out, let's slow down the tempo next week. Taking 3 to 4 seconds to lower the weight increases time under tension to build strength without adding a single kilo.

We have a couple of other great options to try too if you prefer, but this is my top pick.
